channel.title: Carlos Georges — notes
channel.description: Hardware, Linux, and the details worth writing down.

item.title: Linux printed “ready.” The shell still didn’t work.
item.description: A CSR write latched a live interrupt bit and left the shell stuck. I fixed it and checked the result over UART.

item.title: A smaller TLB made my Linux machine slower.
item.description: An 8-entry TLB used 11.5% less mapped cell area than the 16-entry version, but the same run took about 32% more cycles.

item.title: GPU inference on a PS4
item.description: How I set up recoverable Linux on a PS4 and got Vulkan inference to return the expected output for short prompts.

item.title: Fixing secondary-CPU initialization in m1n1
item.description: Why the timer-control register has to be restored after counter redirection and an ISB on Apple M3 and later.

item.title: An RTL optimization that depended on fixed-point format
item.description: A synthesis result looked useful in one configuration. A later format change exposed a problem with the assumption.

item.title: Choosing better puzzles for Recast
item.description: How I choose dice that support different ways to play and keep Daily puzzle data consistent.

item.title: Tracing failures in dynamic agent teams
item.description: How SOAR records delegation and tool use so I can tell where a run stopped.
